svg.title: Research performance and typical token use
svg.desc: Internal research performance: single-agent index 100, multi-agent index 190.2, derived from a 90.2% relative gain. Separate typical token-use observation: chat about 1×, single agent about 4×, multi-agent about 15×. Neither index is an accuracy percentage. Two separate observations, not a paired efficiency experiment. Performance uses an Opus 4 lead with Sonnet 4 workers against one Opus 4 agent. Absolute evaluation scores are undisclosed. Token multiples describe typical use relative to chat.
svg.metadata: https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/multi-agent-research-system | Internal research evaluation and token-use observations; 13 June 2025
